values.website: A rugged, fanless 4G dual-SIM cellular gateway on MediaTek MT7621 with 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports, SFP uplink, and advanced multi-WAN failover running OpenWRT Linux. Ideal for primary WAN failover, remote SCADA connectivity, and distributed IoT metering deployments.

values.catalogue:
Primary WAN Failover for Retail & Branch Offices — Ideal for ensuring uninterrupted internet connectivity in retail stores and branch offices by automatically switching to a backup 4G/5G network when the primary WAN connection fails, maintaining seamless POS transactions, cloud access, and business operations.
Remote SCADA/Industrial Site Connectivity — Connecting remote industrial equipment, PLCs, RTUs, and SCADA systems over secure 4G/5G networks, enabling real-time data acquisition, remote monitoring, equipment control, and reliable communication between industrial sites and centralized control systems.
Fleet of Distributed IoT/Metering Gateways with Centralized Management — Deploying and managing multiple IoT and metering gateways across geographically distributed locations, enabling centralized device monitoring, remote configuration, firmware updates, and real-time data collection for efficient operations and maintenance.
